name: Bootsausflug auf dem Achensee
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The MS Stadt Innsbruck, the Achensee boat, takes you on a relaxed round trip across Tirol’s largest lake. Along the way, you’ll pass picturesque coves and towering cliffs, enjoying the crisp mountain air and breathtaking views of the Karwendel and Rofangebirge mountains. An optional onboard lunch in the restaurant is available for booking.
